qf-app.service.content:
[Unit]
Description=Quillfern shop (docker compose)
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
WorkingDirectory=/opt/app
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker compose up -d
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker compose down

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

backup.sh.content:
#!/bin/bash
# nightly db dump, keeps 7 days
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/app
STAMP=$(date +%F)
docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U qf_app qf_shop | gzip > /var/backups/qf/qf_shop-$STAMP.sql.gz
find /var/backups/qf -name '*.sql.gz' -mtime +7 -delete
